"import cadquery as cq

L = 80.0       # plate X size
W = 80.0       # plate Y size
T = 8.0        # plate Z thickness (base at z=0, top at z=8)
BOSS_D = 25.0  # boss diameter
BOSS_H = 15.0  # boss height (boss top at z=8+15=23)
HOLE_D = 7.0   # bolt hole diameter
INSET = 28.0   # bolt hole center offset from origin

part = (cq.Workplane("XY")
        .rect(L, W).extrude(T)
        .faces(">Z").workplane().circle(BOSS_D / 2.0).extrude(BOSS_H)
        .faces(">Z").workplane()
        .pushPoints([(INSET, INSET),
                     (-INSET, INSET),
                     (INSET, -INSET),
                     (-INSET, -INSET)])
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0).cutThruAll())

cq.exporters.export(part.val(), "part.step")"
